headline: STERIS Raises Dividend to $0.69 per share
summary: DUBLIN, IRELAND, July 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- STERIS plc (NYSE: STE) (“STERIS” or the “Company”) announced today that the Company will distribute a quarterly interim dividend of $0.69 per share. This represents a $0.06 increase in the dividend and the Company’s 21st consecutive year of dividend growth.
